name: Julia Payne
why: Studio portrait from the underclassmen grid of the 2012 Talisman, printed page 362. Names are printed four to a group in a column beside each row of four portraits and read left to right against them. Her group reads WILLIAM PARKER, VERENA PATTON, ASHTYN PAYNE, JULIA PAYNE and she is the fourth. The reading direction was proved on this same page: the first group reads ALEC NEWTON, ANGELA NG, TIEN NGUYEN, ANN NIMMO against a man, a woman, an East Asian woman and a woman, and every group on the page is alphabetical and matches on sex.

name: Jane Wood
why: Fourth from the left in the front row of SGA's own group photograph in the 2012 Talisman, printed page 386, which carries a full left-to-right key: 'Row 1: Cory Dodds, Kendrick Bryan, Travis Tosler, Jane Wood, Billy Stephens, Kaylee Egerer, Rachel Calhoun, Catherine Haver.' Three things fix Row 1 as the front row read left to right. It holds exactly eight people, as the key says. Its sexes run man, man, man, woman, man, woman, woman, woman, exactly as the key names them. And position two is unmistakably Kendrick Bryan when set beside the portrait the archive already holds of him: the same rectangular glasses, the same hairline swept across the forehead, the same long narrow face. Position six is likewise consistent with the archive's Kaylee Egerer. The face is soft, about forty-five pixels across, but it is one clear subject.
caption_quote: Row 1: Cory Dodds, Kendrick Bryan, Travis Tosler, Jane Wood, Billy Stephens, Kaylee Egerer, Rachel Calhoun, Catherine Haver.
